name: USDA: attaché (GAIN) reports, World Markets and Trade, ERS outlook
access: public: GAIN API and PDFs, FAS PSD circulars, ERS publications
note: GAIN reports are written by USDA's overseas posts and are not official USDA estimates; the official number is the one in the report's own table (USDA Official). Following the desk's rule, the points show how far Post is from USDA and how Post changed its own numbers, not the levels alone.

entries.title: FAS Sugar: World Markets and Trade, November 2026 — China Sugar Deficit Falls to 10-Year Low, Curbing Imports
key_points: With ample stocks, the forecast for sugar imports is revised down to about 4.2  million metric tons, raw value (tons) in 2025/26 and even lower in 2026/27 to 3.6 million tons.
China’s sugar deﬁcit is estimated at 2.4 million tons in 2025/26, 42 percent lower than in 2024/25  and the lowest ﬁgure in a decade
With crop production greatly outpacing demand, stocks are expected to swell

entries.title: ERS Sugar and Sweeteners Outlook: August 2026
key_points: Beginning stocks are raised 219,000 STRV on  upward adjustments to the 2025/26 beet sugar production and imports.
U.S. sugar use is  unchanged at 12.571 million STRV.
Thus, ending stocks are at 1.865 million STRV (up  169,000) and the stocks-to-use ratio is 14.8 percent (up 1.3 percentage points from last  month’s 13.5 percent).

entries.title: ERS Sugar and Sweeteners Outlook: July 2026
key_points: The revisions ultimately result in a lower 2026/27 beginning stocks and larger projected  deliveries.

Sugar supply is forecast at 14.268 million short tons, raw value (STRV), up 94,000  STRV from last month as the decreases in beginning stocks and beet sugar production are  more than offset by increases in cane sugar production and imports mostly from Mexico.
Sugar use is raised  56,000 STRV to 12.571 million, solely on increased deliveries for human consumption

entries.title: ERS Sugar and Sweeteners Outlook: June 2026
key_points: Sugar use is raised 126,000 STRV to 12.515 million  STRV, solely on increased deliveries for human consumption.
The resulting 2026/27  ending stocks are 1.660 million STRV, down 13,000 STRV from last month, and the  corresponding stocks-to-use ratio is 13.3 percent.
Mexico’s 2026/27 sugar production is raised 141,000 metric tons, actual weight to 5.283 million  metric tons based on USDA, Foreign Agricultural Service’s Mexico City Post.

entries.title: ERS Sugar and Sweeteners Outlook: May 2026
key_points: Sugar use is unchanged from 2025/26 at 12.389 million  STRV.
The resulting ending stocks are 1.673 million STRV, down about 300,000 STRV.
Mexico’s 2026/27 sugar production is forecast at 5.142 million metric tons (MT), slightly below  2025/26, based on USDA, Foreign Agricultural Service’s Mexico City Post.

key_points: Sugar use is raised 69,000  STRV
